title: Senior Embedded Linux Firmware Development Lead Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Embedded Linux Firmware Development Lead Engineer 
Job Description:
 Senior Embedded Linux Firmware Development Lead Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance, secure Linux-based systems for embedded devices (ARM/MIPS, IoT hubs, gateways). The role spans the full product lifecycle, from bootloader/board bring-up to kernel optimization, middleware integration, and production provisioning. The Embedded Lead will be responsible for designing and developing embedded systems architecture, integrating hardware and firmware components, and ensuring that embedded systems meet high-quality standards. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to define system requirements, develop architectural guidelines, and lead the development of innovative solutions to meet customer needs.
 Key Responsibilities:
 System Architecture & Design: Lead the architectural design of embedded Linux systems, selecting proper middleware, libraries, and kernel versions. Board Support Package (BSP) Development: Develop and maintain custom BSPs, including U-Boot optimization, Device Tree configurations, and kernel customization. Driver & Kernel Development: Write, debug, and optimize Linux kernel drivers and modules (I2C, SPI, UART, PCIe, USB, Display, Camera). User-space Development: Implement complex applications in C/C++ for embedded Linux, utilizing IPC, POSIX threads, and sockets. Build Systems & Toolchains: Build, maintain, and customize firmware images using Yocto Project or Buildroot . Performance Optimization: Optimize system boot time, resource usage (CPU/memory), and power consumption. Security & Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates: Implement secure boot, hardware security modules (HSM), and reliable OTA mechanisms (e.g., SWUpdate, Mender). Debugging & Testing: Drive deep debugging using GDB, JTAG, logic analyzers, and system tracing tools (perf, strace). Mentorship: Provide technical leadership and mentor junior engineers. Skills and Tools Required: - Strong experience in embedded systems design and architecture.
 - Proficient in programming languages such as C and C++, Python with hands-on experience in embedded domain Languages: Expert-level C/C++ programming; proficient in scripting (Bash, Python). Kernel/Driver: Deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, device drivers, and device tree. - Embedded web app experience is good to have - Expertise in Microcontrollers (STM32) and Microprocessors
 - Experience with real-time operating systems (FreeRTOS or any RTOS) and embedded Linux.
 - Knowledge of hardware design principles, including microcontrollers and microprocessors.
 - Familiarity with software development life cycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies. - Good to have Azure Deveops knowledge.
 - Experience with debugging tools and methodologies for embedded software.
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
 - Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and project management tools.
 Preferred Qualifications:
 - Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics Engineering or a related field.
 Mandatory Skills WiFi, Embedded C, Communication Protocols

Key Skills: Yocto,Linux Bsp,Linux Kernel,Embedded Linux,Linux,Firmware,Embedded systems,Bsp

title: Firmware Testing Engineer
description:
Job Description Firmware Testing Engineer Position: Firmware Testing Engineer
 Department: Research & Development (R&D)
 Location: R&D Centre, Pune
 Experience: 1–2 Years
 Qualification: Diploma / BE in Electronics, Electrical or Instrumentation Engineering Job Purpose We are looking for a Firmware Testing Engineer to validate embedded firmware performance on actual HVAC electronic products. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring functional correctness, control logic accuracy, product reliability and seamless integration between firmware and hardware before product release. Key Responsibilities Perform functional testing of firmware on actual HVAC electronic hardware such as PCBs, controllers, sensors and actuators. Validate firmware control logic and algorithms against design specifications. Design, execute and document test cases and test plans covering functional, boundary and stress testing. Perform regression testing after firmware updates, bug fixes and new releases. Identify, reproduce, log and track firmware defects/bugs. Support root-cause analysis and troubleshooting in coordination with firmware developers. Perform integration testing between firmware and hardware components such as sensors, relays, compressors, motors, displays and communication modules. Prepare detailed test reports, defect reports and validation summaries. Maintain testing equipment, fixtures and testing documentation. Collaborate closely with Firmware, Hardware and Electrical teams to ensure product reliability. Follow applicable industry and safety standards such as BIS, UL and CE, along with internal quality requirements. Contribute towards improving and standardizing test procedures, defect logging and validation processes. Required Technical Skills Hands-on experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers and firmware testing . Good understanding of electronic circuits and ability to read circuit schematics. Hands-on experience with Oscilloscope, Multimeter, Signal Generator and Power Supply . Understanding of communication protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI, RS485 and Modbus . Ability to create clear and structured test cases and test reports. Strong defect identification, troubleshooting and analytical skills. Basic programming/scripting knowledge in C and Python . Basic understanding of test automation tools/frameworks. Knowledge of relevant HVAC electronics safety/compliance standards such as BIS, UL and CE . Preferred Experience Prior experience in HVAC products such as Air Conditioners, Chillers, Controllers, Thermostats or VRF systems. Exposure to firmware test automation tools and frameworks. Behavioral Competencies Strong attention to detail. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Patience and persistence in troubleshooting intermittent issues. Good communication and teamwork skills. Ability to work independently. Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis mindset. Working Conditions Primarily a lab-based, hands-on testing environment. Occasional travel to factory/site locations may be required. Testing may involve different environmental and operating conditions.

Key Skills: Embedded Testing,PCB Testing,Firmware Testing,Hardware Testing,Oscilloscope,CRO,Signal Generator,Multimeter
